package main

import (
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3/go/pulumi"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/clickhouse"
)

func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {
		filtered, err := clickhouse.GetInstances(ctx, &clickhouse.GetInstancesArgs{
			InstanceName: pulumi.StringRef("test"),
			Tags: map[string]string{
				"env": "test",
			},
			IsSimple:         pulumi.BoolRef(true),
			ResultOutputFile: pulumi.StringRef("clickhouse_instances.json"),
		}, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		ctx.Export("instanceCount", len(filtered.InstanceLists))
		ctx.Export("firstInstance", len(filtered.InstanceLists).ApplyT(func(length int) (clickhouse.GetInstancesInstanceList, error) {
			var tmp0 clickhouse.GetInstancesInstanceList
			if length > 0 {
				tmp0 = clickhouse.GetInstancesInstanceList(filtered.InstanceLists[0])
			} else {
				tmp0 = nil
			}
			return tmp0, nil
		}).(clickhouse.GetInstancesInstanceListOutput))
		return nil
	})
}
